message.content: {"action":"decrease_precision","reason":"The current best quality-passing point is the 16-bit LUT (area 1584.6), while the 14-bit LUT fails the 8-LSB quality check. Since increase_precision and table-capacity changes have no legal unvisited neighbors, decreasing precision is the only available action that can explore a smaller-area point near the quality boundary. This balances numerical quality and mapped area by testing whether a lower-precision configuration can still meet the quality target at lower cost."}
